source: 新架构将核心交易的平均响应时间缩短了一半。
target: The new architecture halves the average response time of all transactions.
error_info: 将适用对象“核心交易”歪曲为“全部交易”，范围被扩大。

source: 该功能上线后有望显著降低人工运维成本。
target: After this feature goes live, it will completely eliminate manual operations costs.
error_info: 将“有望显著降低”歪曲为“完全消除”，程度被严重夸大。

source: 除核心数据库外，其他系统均已完成升级。
target: All systems, including the core database, have completed the upgrade.
error_info: 将排除关系“除核心数据库外”歪曲为包含核心数据库，升级范围被改变。

source: 该套餐包含的技术支持服务以远程支持为主。
target: The technical support included in this package is delivered mainly on-site.
error_info: 将“以远程支持为主”歪曲为“以现场支持为主”，服务交付方式被改变。

source: 未经审批，任何人不得将生产数据复制到测试环境。
target: Production data may be copied to the test environment after obtaining verbal approval from the team lead.
error_info: 将“未经审批不得复制”歪曲为“组长口头同意即可复制”，审批要求被篡改。

source: 系统恢复后，丢失的数据可以从昨天的备份中找回。
target: After the system is restored, the lost data can be recovered by recomputing all historical transactions.
error_info: 将数据恢复来源“昨天的备份”歪曲为“重新计算全部历史交易”。

source: 工程师表示，当前网络抖动属于偶发现象，无需处理。
target: The engineer stated that the current network jitter is a permanent phenomenon and requires no action.
error_info: 将“偶发现象”歪曲为“永久现象”，故障性质被改变。

source: 灰度发布先向小部分用户开放新版本。
target: The canary release first makes the new version available to the majority of users.
error_info: 将“小部分用户”歪曲为“大多数用户”，灰度范围被颠倒。

source: 该安全策略默认对所有新创建的存储桶生效。
target: This security policy applies by default only to storage buckets created before this year.
error_info: 将“所有新创建的桶”歪曲为“仅今年之前创建的桶”，生效范围被篡改。

source: 外包人员的访问权限仅限于指定的测试服务器。
target: Outsourcing personnel have full access to all test servers.
error_info: 将“仅限指定测试服务器”歪曲为“对全部测试服务器拥有完全权限”。

source: 该接口返回的数据已经按交易时间倒序排列。
target: The data returned by this interface is sorted in descending order by transaction amount.
error_info: 排序字段由“交易时间”被歪曲为“交易金额”，数据含义改变。

source: 停用某节点后，集群会自动将其负载迁移到其他节点。
target: After a node is shut down, its load is permanently lost and cannot be migrated.
error_info: 将“集群自动迁移负载”歪曲为“负载永久丢失且不可迁移”，集群能力被否定。

source: 本手册中的截图均来自测试环境，实际界面可能略有差异。
target: All screenshots in this manual are taken from the production environment; the actual interface may differ slightly.
error_info: 将截图来源“测试环境”歪曲为“生产环境”。

source: 该策略允许用户临时提权十五分钟处理紧急故障。
target: The policy allows users to permanently elevate privileges for fifteen minutes to handle emergency faults.
error_info: 将“临时提权”歪曲为“永久提权”，授权性质被改变（严重安全含义错误）。

source: 项目组计划在第二季度末完成大部分存量系统的迁移。
target: The project team plans to complete the migration of a small portion of the legacy systems by the end of the second quarter.
error_info: 将“大部分”歪曲为“小部分”，计划完成比例被改变。

source: 该参数调整后只影响新建立的连接，已有连接不受影响。
target: After this parameter is adjusted, it affects all existing connections as well as newly established ones.
error_info: 将“已有连接不受影响”歪曲为“已有连接也受影响”，影响范围被扩大。

source: 客户应当自行保管根账户的访问密钥，云厂商不代为保存。
target: The cloud vendor stores the access keys of root accounts on behalf of customers, who should also keep them carefully.
error_info: 将保管责任“客户自行保管、厂商不保存”歪曲为“云厂商代为保存”。

source: 该压缩算法特别适合日志、文档等文本类数据。
target: This compression algorithm is especially suitable for binary data such as videos and images.
error_info: 将适用对象“日志、文档等文本类数据”歪曲为“视频、图片等二进制数据”。

source: 本次培训对象为入职不满一年的新员工。
target: This training is intended for senior employees who have been with the company for over five years.
error_info: 将培训对象“入职不满一年的新员工”歪曲为“入职五年以上的老员工”。

source: 该容灾方案的RPO为五分钟，即最多丢失五分钟数据。
target: With an RPO of five minutes, this disaster recovery solution guarantees zero data loss.
error_info: 将“最多丢失五分钟数据”歪曲为“零数据丢失”，保障能力被夸大。

source: 试运行期间，新系统与旧系统并行承载业务。
target: During the trial run, only the new system carries the business, while the old system remains shut down.
error_info: 将“新旧系统并行承载”歪曲为“仅新系统运行、旧系统停机”，运行安排被改变。

source: 该监控指标反映的是磁盘的剩余可用容量。
target: This monitoring metric reflects the disk capacity that has already been used.
error_info: 将“剩余可用容量”歪曲为“已使用容量”，指标含义被改变。

source: 该账号仅在每日凌晨的批处理时段具备写权限。
target: This account has write permissions throughout the entire day, including the batch processing window.
error_info: 将“仅限凌晨批处理时段有写权限”歪曲为“全天有写权限”，授权时段被扩大。

source: 变更实施后的观察期内，各系统负责人须每小时汇报一次运行情况。
target: During the observation period after the change, each system owner only needs to report the operating status once.
error_info: 将“每小时汇报一次”歪曲为“只需汇报一次”，汇报频次被改变。

source: 该套餐的免费技术支持服务期限为自开通之日起一年。
target: The free technical support service for this package is valid indefinitely from the activation date.
error_info: 将服务期限“一年”歪曲为“永久有效”，承诺范围被改变。

source: 调用旧版接口时会在响应头中收到弃用提醒。
target: When calling the new version of the API, a deprecation notice is returned in the response header.
error_info: 将触发对象“旧版接口”歪曲为“新版接口”。

source: 该报告仅统计已闭环的故障工单，处理中的工单不计入。
target: The report only counts fault tickets that are still in progress, excluding closed tickets.
error_info: 将统计口径“已闭环工单”歪曲为“处理中工单”，统计范围被颠倒。

source: 主库提交事务后，变更会通过同步链路复制到备库。
target: After the standby database commits the transaction, the change is replicated to the primary database through the synchronization link.
error_info: 主备复制方向颠倒：应为“主库提交后复制到备库”。

source: 只有当所有健康检查均通过时，流量才会被转发到该后端服务器。
target: Traffic is forwarded to the backend server only when all health checks have failed.
error_info: 条件逻辑颠倒：健康检查“失败”才转发（应为全部通过才转发）。

source: 由于上联端口发生拥塞，多台云主机出现了网络延迟。
target: The uplink port became congested because multiple cloud hosts experienced network latency.
error_info: 因果倒置：云主机网络延迟被说成上联端口拥塞的原因。

source: 先关闭应用进程，再卸载挂载的数据盘。
target: First unmount the mounted data disk, and then shut down the application process.
error_info: 操作顺序颠倒：应为先关闭应用进程、再卸载数据盘。

source: 如果配置校验不通过，升级程序将终止并回滚所有更改。
target: If the configuration validation passes, the upgrade program terminates and rolls back all changes.
error_info: 条件逻辑颠倒：校验“通过”时终止回滚（应为不通过时才终止回滚）。

source: 数据包先经过负载均衡器，再被转发到后端的应用服务器。
target: Data packets are first forwarded to the backend application server and then pass through the load balancer.
error_info: 转发顺序颠倒：应为先经过负载均衡器、再到后端服务器。

source: 尽管主链路中断，备用链路仍保证了业务连续性。
target: Although the standby link was interrupted, the primary link ensured business continuity.
error_info: 主备角色颠倒：中断的是主链路，保障业务连续性的是备用链路。

source: 提交变更申请后，必须等待审批结果才能执行操作。
target: You must wait for the approval result before submitting the change request.
error_info: 先后顺序颠倒：应为先提交变更申请、再等待审批结果。

source: 缓存未命中时，请求会穿透到后端数据库。
target: On a cache hit, the request penetrates to the backend database.
error_info: 条件逻辑颠倒：应为缓存未命中（cache miss）时才穿透到数据库。

source: 因为新版本存在兼容性问题，团队决定推迟上线。
target: The new version had compatibility problems because the team decided to postpone the launch.
error_info: 因果倒置：推迟上线被说成产生兼容性问题的原因。

source: 主节点负责写操作，从节点只能处理读请求。
target: The primary node can only handle read requests, while the standby node handles write operations.
error_info: 主从读写职责颠倒：主节点写、从节点读被译反。

source: 如果磁盘IO等待持续高于20%，应当排查存储链路。
target: You should troubleshoot the storage link only when disk I/O wait remains below 20 percent.
error_info: 条件方向颠倒：应为持续“高于”20%才排查，译文变成“低于”才排查。

source: 用户输入正确验证码之后才能完成二次验证。
target: The second-factor verification can only be completed before the user enters the correct verification code.
error_info: 时间顺序颠倒：应为输入正确验证码“之后”完成验证。

source: 交换机获取到IP地址后再开始转发用户流量。
target: The switch starts forwarding user traffic first, and then obtains an IP address.
error_info: 先后顺序颠倒：应为先获取IP地址、后转发流量。

source: 虽然两地相距一千公里，同步复制仍将延迟控制在十毫秒以内。
target: Although synchronous replication keeps the latency within ten milliseconds, the two sites are one thousand kilometers apart.
error_info: 让步逻辑错位：相距一千公里是让步背景，译文将其放到结果句中，逻辑关系颠倒。

source: 扩容的触发条件是CPU利用率连续五分钟超过80%。
target: Scaling is triggered when CPU utilization stays below 80 percent for five consecutive minutes.
error_info: 触发条件方向颠倒：应为“超过”80%触发扩容，译文变为“低于”80%触发。

source: 接入层先对请求做身份鉴权，鉴权通过后才转发至业务层。
target: The access layer first forwards requests to the business layer and then performs identity authentication on them.
error_info: 处理顺序颠倒：应为先鉴权、通过后再转发。

source: 由于光纤被意外挖断，跨区域业务自动切换到了备用通道。
target: The fiber was accidentally cut because cross-regional services automatically switched to the standby channel.
error_info: 因果倒置：业务切换到备用通道被说成光纤被挖断的原因。

source: 即使备份成功，也需要定期校验备份数据的可恢复性。
target: Even if the backup fails, the recoverability of the backup data must be verified periodically.
error_info: 让步条件颠倒：应为即使备份“成功”也要校验，译文变为备份“失败”时校验。

source: 控制器A处于主用状态时，控制器B处于备用状态。
target: When controller A is in standby state, controller B is also in standby state.
error_info: 主备互备关系被颠倒：译文变成两个控制器同时处于备用状态。

source: 系统检测到攻击签名后，会先阻断连接再产生告警。
target: After detecting an attack signature, the system first raises an alarm and then blocks the connection.
error_info: 处置顺序颠倒：应为先阻断连接、再产生告警。

source: 若两块系统盘均发生故障，本地高可用将无法继续提供服务。
target: If both system disks fail, local high availability continues to provide services without interruption.
error_info: 结果逻辑颠倒：双盘均故障时“无法继续服务”被说成“继续不中断服务”。

source: 发布单审批通过之后，才能在生产环境执行部署脚本。
target: The deployment script can be executed in production before the release ticket is approved.
error_info: 时序与条件颠倒：应为审批“通过之后”才能执行，译文变为审批之前即可执行。

source: 云平台优先在可用区A创建实例，A资源不足时再调度到可用区B。
target: The cloud platform first creates the instance in Availability Zone B, and schedules it to Availability Zone A only when resources are insufficient.
error_info: 调度优先级颠倒：应为优先A区、A资源不足时才调度到B区。

source: 由于证书已过期，浏览器对该网站弹出了安全警告。
target: The certificate expired because the browser displayed a security warning for the website.
error_info: 因果倒置：浏览器弹出安全警告被说成证书过期的原因。

source: 服务器通过交换机接入核心网络。
target: The server accesses the core network through a switchboard.
error_info: 术语错误：交换机应为switch，switchboard指电话总机/配电盘。

source: 该链路的标称带宽为10Gbps。
target: The nominal broadband of this link is 10 Gbps.
error_info: 术语错误：带宽应为bandwidth，broadband指宽带（接入服务）。

source: 攻击者利用该漏洞可以在服务器上执行任意命令。
target: Attackers can exploit this loophole to execute arbitrary commands on the server.
error_info: 术语错误：安全漏洞应为vulnerability，loophole多指法律/规则空子。

source: 该中间件负责应用与数据库之间的连接管理。
target: This middle software is responsible for connection management between the application and the database.
error_info: 术语错误：中间件标准术语为middleware，middle software为自造词。

source: 所有外部访问必须经过反向代理服务器。
target: All external access must pass through a reverse agent server.
error_info: 术语错误：反向代理应为reverse proxy，agent指代理（人/智能体）。

source: 堡垒机会对运维人员的所有操作进行录像审计。
target: The fortress machine records and audits all operations performed by maintenance personnel.
error_info: 术语错误：堡垒机标准术语为bastion host/jump server，fortress machine为中式直译。

source: 该数据中心采用双活架构，两个站点同时对外提供服务。
target: This data center adopts a double-active architecture, in which both sites provide external services at the same time.
error_info: 术语错误：双活标准术语为active-active，double-active为非标准译法。

source: 用户登录系统需要通过多因素认证。
target: Users must pass multi-element authentication when logging in to the system.
error_info: 术语错误：多因素认证应为multi-factor authentication（MFA）。

source: 运维团队建成了覆盖核心业务的灾备体系。
target: The operations team built a disaster preparation system covering core services.
error_info: 术语错误：灾备（灾难恢复）应为disaster recovery（DR），disaster preparation为自造说法。

source: 云平台支持根据业务负载自动进行弹性伸缩。
target: The cloud platform supports automatic elastic expansion according to business load.
error_info: 术语错误：弹性伸缩标准术语为auto scaling/elastic scaling，elastic expansion只表示扩容且非标准说法。

source: 网络地址转换设备会修改数据包的源IP地址。
target: The network address transformation device modifies the source IP address of data packets.
error_info: 术语错误：网络地址转换为Network Address Translation（NAT），应为translation。

source: 浏览器与服务器之间通过TLS协议加密通信。
target: The browser and server communicate over the Transport Layer Safe protocol.
error_info: 术语错误：TLS全称Transport Layer Security，应为Security而非Safe。

source: 证书颁发机构负责核验证书申请者的身份。
target: The Certificate Authorization is responsible for verifying the identity of certificate applicants.
error_info: 术语错误：证书颁发机构CA为Certificate Authority，不是Authorization。

source: 建议在网络边界部署入侵检测系统。
target: It is recommended to deploy an invasion detection system at the network boundary.
error_info: 术语错误：入侵检测应为intrusion detection system（IDS），invasion指武装入侵。

source: 安全团队每季度对核心系统开展一次渗透测试。
target: The security team conducts a permeation test on the core systems once every quarter.
error_info: 术语错误：渗透测试应为penetration test，permeation指液体渗透。

source: 攻击者通过暴力破解获取了管理员的账户密码。
target: The attacker obtained the administrator's account password through violent cracking.
error_info: 术语错误：暴力破解应为brute-force attack/cracking，violent cracking为中式直译。

source: 物联网终端设备的安全加固是本年度重点工作。
target: Security hardening for Internet of Devices terminals is a key task this year.
error_info: 术语错误：物联网为Internet of Things（IoT），不是Internet of Devices。

source: 容器编排平台负责管理容器的生命周期。
target: The container arrangement platform is responsible for managing the lifecycle of containers.
error_info: 术语错误：容器编排应为container orchestration，arrangement意为排列/安排。

source: 微服务架构将单体应用拆分为多个独立服务。
target: The microservices architecture splits a monolithic application into multiple independent servers.
error_info: 术语/概念错误：拆分出的是服务（services），不是服务器（servers）。

source: 读写分离可以显著降低主库的查询压力。
target: Read-write division can significantly reduce query pressure on the primary database.
error_info: 术语错误：读写分离标准说法为read-write splitting，division为误译。

source: 该系统的年度可用性达到了99.99%。
target: The annual usability of the system reaches 99.99 percent.
error_info: 术语错误：SLA语境下“可用性”应为availability，usability指产品易用性。

source: 平均无故障时间是评估硬件可靠性的重要指标。
target: Average Trouble-Free Time is an important metric for evaluating hardware reliability.
error_info: 术语错误：平均无故障时间为MTBF（Mean Time Between Failures），Average Trouble-Free Time为中式自造说法。

source: 发生灾难后，系统应在RTO要求的时间内恢复服务。
target: After a disaster, the system should restore services within the required Recover Time Object.
error_info: 术语错误：RTO为Recovery Time Objective，译文中Recover/Object两处均误。

source: 两个站点之间配置了同步复制以保证数据一致。
target: Synchronous copy is configured between the two sites to ensure data consistency.
error_info: 术语错误：存储/数据库“复制”应为replication，copy指单次复制文件的动作。

source: 该函数采用异步方式调用远程服务。
target: This function invokes the remote service in a non-synchronized manner.
error_info: 术语错误：异步应为asynchronous，non-synchronized为非标准释义。

source: 系统支持为磁盘卷创建快照以便快速回滚数据。
target: The system supports taking snap photos of disk volumes to roll back data quickly.
error_info: 术语错误：存储快照为snapshot，snap photo为口语化误译。

source: 虚拟机监控器负责为各虚拟机分配物理资源。
target: The virtual machine supervisor is responsible for allocating physical resources to each virtual machine.
error_info: 术语错误：虚拟机监控器（hypervisor）应为virtual machine monitor（VMM），supervisor为另一概念。

source: 内容分发网络可以加快静态资源的访问速度。
target: A Content Distribution Network can speed up access to static resources.
error_info: 术语错误：CDN全称为Content Delivery Network，应为Delivery而非Distribution。

source: 域名解析故障导致用户无法访问该网站。
target: The domain name analysis failure prevented users from accessing the website.
error_info: 术语错误：域名解析应为DNS/name resolution，analysis意为（问题）分析。

source: 当后端服务持续超时时，熔断器会快速失败以保护调用方。
target: When the backend service keeps timing out, the fusing device fails fast to protect the caller.
